title: Thailand school shooting: eight killed including suspected attacker, police say
summary_full: Teenager killed his grandparents ⁠before opening fire at school near Bangkok, where 22 others were woundedThailand school shooting – latest updatesA Thai teenager killed his grandparents before opening fire at his school, where he shot five people dead and took his own life, police have said, in an attack that has shaken a country struggling to deal with gun violence.Police said the 14-year-old pupil wounded another 22 people in the school ⁠shooting on the outskirts of Bangkok on Friday morning.  Nine people were in a critical condition, the Thai health department said. Continue reading...
